svg.title: Iron Grind Fitness Gym — Complete Level 1 DFD
svg.desc: Nine process panels in Gane–Sarson notation, with external entities, separately identified data stores, and labeled data flows.

g.text: Iron Grind Fitness Gym — Simplified Level 1 DFD
Gane–Sarson notation · nine processes · named actors and individual data stores
Each data store uses its database table name. Repeated D identifiers refer to the same table; one single-headed flow per pair. For exchanges, the initiating input or store write is shown.
Simplified directional view: return flows are omitted where a pair exchanges data both ways; consult the source model for complete flows.
5.0 · Record QR scans and retrieve visits
Record QR scans and retrieve visits

svg.text: Source: Chapter 3 Level 1 process/actor-flow model and User Login security-store supplement. Standalone complete Level 1 DFD. The Word chapter presents the same model in five panels (Figures 3a-e); Figure 3f isolates the administrator security stores.
